此功能默认停用。启用后，在“服务器与权限”分配功能与通用通知频道；保存后到“运行: This feature is disabled by default. Enable it, assign the feature and general notification channel in Servers & Permissions, save, then register the command in Runtime Tools.

四项操作均仅执行者可见。关联与查询结果由原生交互自动生成，资料不可用时显示实际状: All four operations are visible only to the person who runs them. Native interactions generate the link and lookup results and show the actual status when profile data is unavailable.
